attacks.name: Odinson‘s Ire
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

|!wild| |*Lightning Arc|: After this attack is resolved, choose a number of other enemy characters within |!range| 3 of the defender equal to or less than the number of |!wild| results in the attack roll. The chosen characters suffer 1 |!damage|.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Push|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Push the defender |!range_small|.

attacks.name: I Would Have Words With Thee!
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character Places itself within |!range| 1 of the defender.
After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character Throws it Away |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Have at Thee!
superPowers.body: This character Throws itself |!range_medium|. It does not suffer |!damage| if it collides with another character or terrain feature. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: The Power of Thor
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_large|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: I Say Thee NAY, Villain!
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3 of this character, roll 7 dice. The attacker suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical| and |!wild| in the result. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
